scope: Vitest only; shipped cold recorder with CPU profiling between two unprofiled plain runs
limitation: One runner, fixed phase order and profiler overhead; no causal speedup or full-job savings claim.
limitations: Profiler overhead is included only on the recorded side; this is one ordered same-runner triplet, not a causal estimate or job benchmark.
CPU samples cover the 116 collected profiles; their count is not proof of full worker or process coverage.
Inclusive frame costs overlap and must not be added or presented as removable wall time.
Three signed sample deltas totaling -9 microseconds were preserved in the aggregation, not clamped.
No replay, narrower input key or production deployment is enabled by this profile.
